text: 金十数据8月28日讯，证监会发布关于资本市场支持构建房地产发展新模式的意见。支持上市房地产开发企业并购重组。发挥资本市场在企业并购重组中的主渠道作用，支持上市房地产开发企业综合运用股份、定向可转债、现金等工具收购涉房资产，其中发行股份、定向可转债购买资产的，可以募集配套资金，并用于符合政策要求的房地产项目和支付本次重组交易对价等。建筑等与房地产密切相关行业的上市公司，参照上市房地产开发企业政策执行。
text_en: Jin Shi Data, August 28 — The CSRC issued opinions on supporting the establishment of a new model for real estate development through the capital market. It supports mergers and acquisitions and restructuring of listed real estate development companies. The capital market's main channel role in corporate M&A and restructuring will be leveraged, supporting listed real estate development companies to comprehensively use tools such as shares, targeted convertible bonds, and cash to acquire real estate-related assets. When issuing shares or targeted convertible bonds to purchase assets, matching fundraising can be conducted, with proceeds used for real estate projects meeting policy requirements and paying transaction consideration for the restructuring. Listed companies in industries closely related to real estate, such as construction, will follow the same policies as listed real estate development companies.
